test_title: PYST 48: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

He is the __friendly__ man in the group.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The adjective "**friendly**" should be in its superlative form to describe the man who is the most friendly in the group.
 
• The correct phrase should be "He is the **friendliest** man in the group."
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part A** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He is the **friendliest** man in the group."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A: "He is the friendly man"** – This part of the sentence needs the superlative form of the adjective to show the highest degree of friendliness.
 
• **B: "in the group"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
